summary: Verified all 8 bug fixes for Apollo Builders redesign. Backend regression: 5/5 pytest pass (health stubbed, POST/GET /api/enquiries, 422 validation, no _id leak). Frontend: All 8 explicit fixes verified via Playwright at 1440x900. (1) Fonts: hero h1 + About/Services H1 computed font-family = 'Fraunces, ui-serif, Georgia, serif'; hero-sub p and About p = '"Inter Tight", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif'. (2) Logo: nav-logo = 'https://apollobuilders.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/photo_2025-12-03_10-38-14-e1764907039294.png', naturalWidth=873. Footer uses same brand.logo. (3) Services tiles: [data-testid=services-tiles] contains 4 tiles new-home-builds/home-renovations/bathroom-renovations/kitchen-renovations, each with real apollobuilders.com.au project photo (Clyde/Altona/drouin-7/endevour-hills-after-4) with naturalWidth>1000. SVG present is only the small 'Explore' ArrowUpRight chevron in the CTA label — primary visual is the img. (4) Nav-logo is , textContent empty; 'BUILDERS · EST. MELBOURNE' string absent from DOM. (5) Hero overlay: gradient overlay div found inside hero-section; hero-heading color = rgb(255,255,255). (6) One CTA above the fold: at scrollY=0 on /, page.$('[data-testid=nav-cta]') returned null; after scrolling to 400px, nav-cta appears. (7) Hero height = 486px at 1440x900 (within 360-540 spec, corresponds to 54vh). (8) Hero contains 'Berwick-New-Build-5-e1762576152191.jpg', naturalWidth=1013. Contact form end-to-end submit produced [data-testid=thanks] with 'Thank you — we’ll be in touch soon.' text.
critical_code_review_comments: Font enforcement in index.css uses element selectors (h1..h6 + p/span/a/li) — clean, but note that Nav.jsx <a> links inherit Inter Tight correctly.
Nav.jsx conditionally renders nav-cta (!overHero) — correct DOM-level removal (not just CSS hidden), which the test explicitly validates.
Hero overlay uses double gradient stack (top-to-bottom + left-to-right) for legibility — solid approach for text over variable-brightness project photography.
brand.logo hotlinks from apollobuilders.com.au — works today but consider caching a local copy in /public to avoid CDN dependence and CORS/hotlink protection risks.
